title: PRISM: an extensible data-and-sidecar model for describing and validating research data
description: PRISM (Principled Research Information & Sidecar Model) is a BIDS-compatible validator and toolkit for research data. It pairs every data file with a JSON sidecar of the same name using extensible, lab-definable schemas, so an instrument PRISM has never encountered can be fully described and validated without modifying the software. PRISM ships a validator, format converters, and PRISM Studio, a local graphical interface paired with a matching command-line interface. Its current modalities and template library are oriented toward psychological research, but the underlying mechanism is domain-agnostic.
